Technical Insights & Publications

Perspectives on cloud architecture, infrastructure automation and emerging AI engineering practices.

Featured article · Cloud Architecture & Agentic AI

AWS CloudFormation vs. AI Agents: Understanding Their Roles in Modern Cloud Architecture

AI Agents are not a direct replacement for Infrastructure as Code. CloudFormation provides a repeatable mechanism to provision and manage AWS resources, while AI Agents can interpret goals, gather context, evaluate options and coordinate authorized workflows. The strongest architecture combines both with policy controls, validation, approval and human oversight.

Key themes

  1. CloudFormation and declarative IaC
  2. AI Agent components and tool use
  3. Different workflows and responsibilities
  4. Agent-assisted template generation
  5. Policy and approval architecture
  6. Cloud operations risk analysis
  7. Least privilege and IAM
  8. Human oversight and auditability

Conceptual architecture

User / Developer→AI Agent→Policy & Approval→CI/CD Pipeline→CloudFormation→AWS Resources

The article emphasizes separation of intelligent planning from privileged execution, and recommends validating generated templates and requiring approvals for high-risk changes.
